description: This file implements the basic container object functions for a cryptographic object within the ANSC framework, specifically creating and removing a cryptographic public key object using OpenSSL SSLeay. It defines functions for creating the object, initializing function pointers, and removing the object, with references to cryptographic operations such as RSA signing, verification, DSA signing, verification, Diffie-Hellman key generation, and shared secret agreement.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCryptoPubSSLeayCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes the cryptographic public object, assigning function pointers for cryptographic operations, and returns a handle to the object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubSSLeayRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the cryptographic public object, freeing associated memory.
